waybackify [flags] [command]

check / search / manifest / cache over the spv/waybackify library

Human-operable, xargs-composable front door over spv/waybackify:
hand-check a capture, re-pick a better one, enumerate a file's wayback
refs, or populate the wayback.charlie.dev mirror.

Exit codes: 0 success · 1 domain failure (bad verdict / not found) ·
2 usage error · 3 suspect verdict (check only).

Flags:
  --help|-h   Show help

Commands:
  check       Full wayback-404 verdict for the exact capture
  search      CDX capture query — re-pick a better capture
  manifest    Per-file enumeration of wayback refs
  cache       Fetch the capture into a local bucket image

part of the wayback.charlie.dev mirror tooling
